note: Hand-written split definition for the approved rifle ADS image (read by Tools/pixelart/split_layers.py). Pixel coordinates from the image's top-left. Regions, seeds and colour thresholds were measured on this image (not copied from the hip definition). The base is the image the game shows (rifle_ads_approved_opaque.png); it is only read. See docs/review/player-parts/rifle-ads/README.md.

left.why: left glove on the left side of the handguard, wrist band, sleeve to the bottom-left edge

right.why: right glove at the bottom-right, running off the bottom edge

cellOverrides.why: grey band between the left glove and the sleeve (grey like the gun steel; separated from the gun by outlines)

pixelOverrides.why: shadowed face of the wrist band (dark fill, max channel 30-45) below the glove: farther than outlineWidth from the band cell, so the distance rule gave it to the gun; it is the band's own face continuing down-right to its tip
